title: Елена заступает на смену  (Elena Starts Her Shift)

segments.t: Seconds after Chef Barinov dives into hiding, Nagiyev leads Elena Pavlovna into the kitchen and introduces her as the acting head chef during Barinov's medical leave. Meanwhile in the corridor, Ilya needles Max by asking if Sasha has dumped him yet.
Сейчас сюда придет Елена Павловна.
Что ж у нас?
Внимание все сюда, пока наш шеф-повар.
Вот. Внимание все сюда.
Да, пока наш шеф-повар отдыхает, так сказать.
Лечится. Да.
Значит, с вами сегодня будет вот Елена Павловна.
Волноваться нечего.
Все, ни пуха ни пера.
Что еще?
Мы что, нормально общаться не можем?
Нет, у нас все хорошо.
Тебя Саша бросил?
Right, let's take their exchange slowly and unpack the Russian.
Сейчас сюда придет Елена Павловна.
'Elena Pavlovna is coming in here right now.' The meaning hinges on 'any minute' working together with 'Pavlovna' in spoken Russian.
Что ж у нас?
'What are we going to do?' Sasha brings out the contrast between 'what' and 'on earth' in a few short words.
Внимание все сюда, пока наш шеф-повар.
'Everyone pay attention, while our head chef...' Elena anchors the line on 'attention', while 'head chef' completes the thought. Chef Viktor answers right away.
Вот. Внимание все сюда.
'Here we are. Everyone pay attention.' In Russian, the idea of 'there you go' flows naturally into 'here' without extra filler words.
Да, пока наш шеф-повар отдыхает, так сказать.
'Yes, while our head chef is resting, so to speak.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'yes' before landing on 'say'.
Лечится. Да.
'Getting medical treatment. Yes.' Elena centers this short reply on 'is treated', letting a few direct words carry the whole meaning.
Значит, с вами сегодня будет вот Елена Павловна.
'Elena Pavlovna right here will be working with you today.' The grammar packs 'so' and 'Pavlovna' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
Волноваться нечего.
'There is nothing to worry about.' Sasha brings out the contrast between 'to worry' and 'nothing' in a few short words.
Все, ни пуха ни пера.
'Alright, best of luck to you all.' The meaning hinges on 'all' working together with 'feather' in spoken Russian. Chef Viktor answers right away.
Что еще?
'What now?' In Russian, the idea of 'what' flows naturally into 'else' without extra filler words.
Мы что, нормально общаться не можем?
'Can we not just talk to each other normally?' The meaning hinges on 'we' working together with 'can' in spoken Russian.
Нет, у нас все хорошо.
'No, everything is fine between us.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'there is no' and finishing on 'fine'. Chef Viktor answers right away.
Тебя Саша бросил?
'Did Sasha dump you?' The grammar packs 'you' and 'threw' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange. Now let's listen to the entire scene again without interruption.

Значит, с вами сегодня будет вот Елена Павловна.

Что еще?

Нет, у нас все хорошо.
Тебя Саша бросил?
That wraps up this scene as nagiyev introduces Elena Pavlovna to the stunned kitchen crew as their temporary chef while Barinov hides, and Ilya taunts Max about Sasha in the hallway. Until next time!
До встречи!
